title: Progress cell
description: JSON Schema for a progress-cell: a predication-cell whose predicate is a progress-measurement morphism and whose value carries a progress measurement.

target.description: Reference to the work or task target of progress measurement.

value.description: The progress measurement. Shape depends on measurement-kind: fraction = number in [0,1], stage = string, boolean = bool, structured = object.

monotone-since.description: Reference to the prior progress-cell this measurement supersedes (asserting monotonicity).
